a: JagX can chat and translate across many languages via its cloud model, including major world and Nigerian languages.
Just write in that language, or say 'reply in <language>' or 'translate to <language>'.
JagX detects the language you write in and answers in the same one by default.
You can mix languages in one chat; say which language you want for the answer.
Programming languages (Python, JS) are separate from human languages (English, Tagalog).
JagX accepts Unicode text so accents, Arabic, Chinese, and emoji work.
If you need Latin letters for another script, ask for romanization.
Ask for formal or informal tone when translating (e.g. formal Japanese).
Multilingual JagX AI — built by JagX and JRILICENSE.
